content_html:
Peru continues to modernize to receive thousands of travelers from all over the world, and in 2025 one of the most important air transport projects in the country will be inaugurated: the new terminal at the Jorge Chávez International Airport in Lima.

If you are planning your trip to Cusco, this change can significantly improve your experience. Here we tell you everything you need to know.

What is the new Lima Air Terminal?

The new Jorge Chávez Airport terminal seeks to turn Lima into a true international hub of connections in South America. This modern space has been designed to offer:

  • Greater capacity for national and international flights.
  • New boarding areas, more comfortable and modern.
  • Greater speed in immigration and customs processes.
  • Improved passenger services: more shops, restaurants and rest spaces.

The new terminal is part of an ambitious infrastructure project that will also include new runways, road accesses and logistics areas.

How does it benefit travelers who go to Cusco?

For many travelers, Lima is the first stop when arriving in Peru, before continuing on your way to Cusco, the Sacred Valley or Machu Picchu. These are some of the advantages that the new terminal brings:

  • Less waiting times and better connection between flights.
  • Greater comfort for those who have long layovers or night flights.
  • Ease of taking domestic flights to Cusco, with better signage and services.
  • Greater safety and efficiency, which makes your arrival in Peru more peaceful.

Recommendations when arriving at the new terminal

  • Confirm your local boarding gate to Cusco with time, since it may change with the new distribution of the terminal.
  • Take advantage of airport services, such as rest areas or WiFi access, especially if your flight to Cusco is the next day.
  • Consider book a private transfer or authorized taxi service from the terminal if you are spending the night in Lima.

From Lima to Cusco with GT Peru Travel

In GT Peru Travel, we accompany travelers from all over the world on their adventure to the heart of the Andean world. If you arrive in Peru through Lima and plan to visit Cusco, we offer you:

  • Personalized assistance from your arrival.
  • Safe and reliable tours to the Sacred Valley, Machu Picchu, the Mountain of Seven Colors and more.
  • Flexible options to adapt to your time, budget and travel style.

Conclusion

The new terminal in Lima is great news for those traveling through America and even more through South America to Peru in 2025. This improvement will facilitate transfers, reduce travel stress and offer a more fluid experience from the moment you land.

If you are planning your trip to Cusco, be sure to take advantage of these news... and don't forget that in GT Peru Travel we are here to help you live an unforgettable experience.
